meta.how_verified: Every core test listed was RUN on 2026-11-22 via `npx tsx <file>` from repo root (TMPDIR=scratchpad); all exit 0 in ~2-5s. Bins marked RAN were executed with scratch paths only. Bins marked NOT_RUN write tracked docs/odg/*.json and were left alone.
meta.caveat_global: Nearly every demonstration is a PURE, deterministic ODG module driven by INJECTED seams (stub generators/executors/clocks) inside a provider-written test. That makes them ODG-native code paths, but on synthetic inputs, not real defects or live missions. Only native-project-builder/intelligent-native/native-explore/native-duel reach a live model (ollama 127.0.0.1:11434).
meta.flake: learning-reuse-proof.test.ts failed once under 6-way parallel runs (tsx IPC pipe EADDRINUSE / truncated JSON) and passed serially (12 assertions).
